rationale: The emitted course-project monitoring overview is factual, meaningful and correctly attributed. However its FULL_REQUIREMENT license for request counters AND latency monitoring exceeds the positive assertion anchors supplied to the independent licensing review. Generic Prometheus metrics collection does not independently establish those specific measurements. Other repository code cannot retroactively repair the actual uncited license context. See new-specificity-forensic-J02.json.
